description: This Java source file contains an abstract implementation of a generic service layer for managing entities in a SalesManager application. It provides common CRUD operations and utilizes a DAO for persistence, tailored with generics to operate on various entity types.

classes.name: SalesManagerEntityServiceImpl
classes.description: A generic abstract service implementation for CRUD and management operations on entities, leveraging DAO layer for persistence and generic type parameters for flexibility.

methods.name: SalesManagerEntityServiceImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DAO and determines the entity class type via reflection utilities.

methods.name: getObjectClass
methods.description: Returns the runtime class of the entity managed by this service.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by class and identifier via DAO.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by its identifier.

methods.name: getByField
methods.description: Fetches an entity based on a specified field attribute and its value.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists an entity, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new entity instance, delegating to createEntity method.

methods.name: createEntity
methods.description: Internal method to save a new entity, can include additional setup.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an entity, delegating to updateEntity method.

methods.name: updateEntity
methods.description: Internal method to update an existing entity.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the state of the entity from the database.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all entities.

methods.name: listByField
methods.description: Returns a list of entities filtered by a specific field and value.
